name: Guangzhou Newlife New Material CO., LTD
summary: Guangzhou Newlife New Material CO., LTD engages in the research and development, production, and sales of magnetic materials and devices in China and internationally. It provides magnetic materials, such as flexible magnets, permanent magnets, multifunctional printing adhesive, write and wipe film materials, and decorative building materials; high energy radiation protection materials, including medical radiation, industrial radiation, and nuclear ray protection materials; and electronic ceramic elements comprising ring varistors, metal oxide varistors, NTC thermistors, and other materials.
